title: Sync settings

autoSync.title: Auto sync
autoSync.subtitle: Keeps your devices in sync automatically.
autoSync.wifiOnlySubtitle: Save mobile data by syncing automatically only on Wi‑Fi

mediaPreview.chatThumbnailsWifiOnlySubtitle: If a file isn't on this device yet, download it only on Wi‑Fi

mediaBackup.title: File uploads
mediaBackup.subtitle: Uploads encrypted photos, videos, audio, and other files in the background for cross-device access
mediaBackup.wifiOnlySubtitle: Avoid using mobile data for large uploads
mediaBackup.description: New files are encrypted and uploaded in the background so they stay available across your devices. Missing files are downloaded on demand when you open them.
mediaBackup.managedVaultOnly: File uploads are available with WebDAV or SecondLoop Cloud sync.
mediaBackup.wifiOnlyBlocked: Wi‑Fi only is on. Connect to Wi‑Fi, or allow mobile data just this once.

cellularDialog.title: Use mobile data?
cellularDialog.message: Wi‑Fi only is on. Uploading over mobile data may use a lot of data.

localCache.subtitle: Deletes cached attachment files on this device (remote copies are kept and can be re-downloaded). Make sure sync/upload has completed.

dialog.title: Delete local cache?
dialog.message: This deletes cached photos and files on this device to save space. Your remote sync storage keeps a copy; items will be re-downloaded on demand when viewed again.

localData.subtitle: Deletes synced local data on this device, including messages, attachments, and embeddings. Your sync settings are kept; Download will fully replace local data from remote again.

dialog.title: Delete local data?
dialog.message: This deletes all synced local data on this device, including messages, attachments, and embeddings. Your sync settings are kept, and a later Download will fully replace local data from remote again.

allData.deletedLocalOnly: Deleted local data only; remote clear timed out, so retry if you still need to remove remote data.

dialog.title: Delete all data?
dialog.message: This deletes all synced local data on this device and clears all remote data for the current sync backend, including WebDAV, local folder sync, or SecondLoop Cloud. Your sync settings are kept.

cloudManagedVault.signInRequired: Sign in to use SecondLoop Cloud sync.
cloudManagedVault.paymentRequired: Cloud sync is paused. Renew your subscription to continue syncing.
cloudManagedVault.storageQuotaExceeded: Cloud storage is full. Uploads are paused.
cloudManagedVault.localSyncDataRepairRequired: Local sync data needs repair before cloud sync can continue.
cloudManagedVault.localChangesUploadRequired: Local changes still need to upload before cloud recovery can continue.
cloudManagedVault.localMediaBackfillRequired: Local media still needs cloud backfill before recovery can continue.
cloudManagedVault.serverUnavailable: Cloud sync is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
cloudManagedVault.storageQuotaExceededWithUsage: Cloud storage is full ($used / $limit). Uploads are paused.

switchDialog.title: Switch to SecondLoop Cloud sync?
switchDialog.message: Your subscription is active. Switch your sync method to SecondLoop Cloud? You can change this anytime.

aiFeatureGuideDialog.title: More AI features are now available
aiFeatureGuideDialog.message: Your Pro subscription unlocked smarter AI setup. Review the recommended AI configuration now, or do it later from Settings > Intelligence.

missingSyncKey: Enter your recovery passphrase and tap Save first.

recoveryHint.title: Recovery package detected
recoveryHint.message: A cloud recovery package is available. Enter your recovery passphrase and tap Recover now.
recoveryHint.fetchFailed: Unable to verify cloud recovery package: $error

localDir.label: Folder path
localDir.helper: Best for desktop; mobile platforms may not support this path.

passphrase.label: Recovery passphrase (Advanced)
passphrase.helper: Use the same recovery passphrase on all devices. It’s never uploaded.
